//: Baseline of KNOWN-NOT-PASSING core tests on a clean tree, captured to make "no new test failures" a trustworthy gate despite a non-deterministic (sharded, memory-pressured) suite.
capturedFrom: stableFailures retired 2026-09-21 after a clean full run showed all 90 passing; flakyFiles still carry the original 2-run intersection method, because one clean run is not evidence about flakiness under sharding.

flakyFiles.//: Whole files that pass in isolation but flake under sharded memory/timing pressure — any failure within these is IGNORED by the gate.

stableFailures.//: EMPTY, and that is the point. This list held 90 entries described as "deterministic pre-existing failures"; on 2026-09-21 a clean full run of the core suite reported "total failures=0 | known-stable=0 | known-flaky=0 | NEW=0" -- not one of the 90 failed. 17 of them could not have: 10 named src/compiler/__tests__/MatterpakCompiler.test.ts, a file that no longer exists, and 7 named test titles that no longer exist either. 19 more were in marketplace-runtime.test.ts, which fails only because @holoscript/auth is unbuilt -- built it, and its 130 tests pass. The list was a fossil of a broken build environment, not a record of defects, and while it stood the gate accepted 90 named failures in advance. A NEW failure is now any failure at all, outside a flaky file.
stableFailures.retiredEvidence: corepack pnpm --filter @holoscript/core test:baseline, clean tree at 0882bc9b6, packages/auth and openusd-plugin built: total failures=0.
